title: Insaf Apne Lahoo Se
desc: Mahendra Pratap marries Geeta, but asks Devilal, her first son, to leave the house. Later, Geeta gets arrested for murder due to her husband's false testimony and gives birth to another son in prison.

title: Nishchaiy
desc: When Ravi is falsely accused of a crime and sentenced to jail, his boss's wife, Renuka, promises to take care of his younger brother. However, Ravi is unable to find his brother after he is released.

title: Zulm O Sitam
desc: Superintendent of Police, Arun, has been assigned to lead the detail in charge of the state's Chief Minister's protection. However, things do not go as planned and the Chief Minister is killed.

title: Jurmana
desc: Inder, a contractor who believes in the power of money, places a bet with his friend Prakash to woo Rama, a simple girl. Rama gets charmed by Inder, but an event forces her to leave the city.
